import * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib';
import * as ec2 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-ec2';
import * as s3 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3';
import * as sqs from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-sqs';
import { Construct } from 'constructs';

export interface OpenIacStackProps extends cdk.StackProps {}

export class OpenIacStack extends cdk.Stack {
  constructor(scope: Construct, id: string, props: OpenIacStackProps = {}) {
    super(scope, id, props);

    // var.region
    const region = this.node.tryGetContext("region") ?? "us-east-1";
    // var.environment
    const environment = this.node.tryGetContext("environment") ?? "dev";

    // aws_s3_bucket.assets
    const assetsS3Bucket = new s3.Bucket(this, "aws_s3_bucket.assets", {
      bucketName: `openiac-assets-${environment}`,
      tags: {"Environment": environment},
    });
    // aws_sqs_queue.jobs
    const jobsSqsQueue = new sqs.CfnQueue(this, "aws_sqs_queue.jobs", {
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600,
      QueueName: "openiac-jobs",
      VisibilityTimeout: 300,
    });
    // aws_vpc.main
    const mainVpc = new ec2.CfnVPC(this, "aws_vpc.main", {
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
      EnableDnsHostnames: true,
      EnableDnsSupport: true,
      Tags: [{ Key: "Environment", Value: environment }, { Key: "Name", Value: `openiac-${environment}` }],
    });
    // aws_security_group.web
    const webSecurityGroup = new ec2.CfnSecurityGroup(this, "aws_security_group.web", {
      GroupDescription: "Allow HTTP from anywhere",
      GroupName: "openiac-web",
      Tags: [{ Key: "Name", Value: "openiac-web" }],
      VpcId: mainVpc.ref,
      SecurityGroupEgress: [{ CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0", FromPort: 0, IpProtocol: "-1", ToPort: 0 }],
      SecurityGroupIngress: [{ CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0", FromPort: 80, IpProtocol: "tcp", ToPort: 80 }],
    });
    // aws_subnet.public
    const publicSubnet = new ec2.CfnSubnet(this, "aws_subnet.public", {
      AvailabilityZone: `${region}a`,
      CidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24",
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true,
      Tags: [{ Key: "Name", Value: "openiac-public" }],
      VpcId: mainVpc.ref,
    });
    // aws_instance.web
    const webInstance = new ec2.CfnInstance(this, "aws_instance.web", {
      ImageId: "ami-0123456789abcdef0",
      InstanceType: "t3.micro",
      SubnetId: publicSubnet.ref,
      Tags: [{ Key: "Name", Value: "openiac-web" }],
      SecurityGroupIds: [webSecurityGroup.attrGroupId],
    });

    // output.bucket_arn
    new cdk.CfnOutput(this, "bucket_arn", { value: assetsS3Bucket.bucketArn });
    // output.instance_ip
    new cdk.CfnOutput(this, "instance_ip", { value: webInstance.attrPublicIp });

  }
}
